conviction_note: The findings add up to +1.2. Most of that is a large, mechanical Q3 bitcoin fair-value gain that will flip GAAP EPS far above a stale consensus loss, plus a low bar on new leases. Against them stand a +30.7 vol-point put skew, a stock that sold its last comparable mark-to-market profit (Q3 2025, about -9.7%), revenue that missed consensus in Q1 and Q2 2026, and a +15% rebound on 2026-11-03 that already unwound part of the drawdown. The evidence is balanced, so p_up is 50 and the scaled number is 0 on an abs_move of 13 taken from the 12.97% option-implied event move. The +1.2 sum and the 0 scaled number differ because the findings are mostly optionality and a below-the-line mark this name has sold before; they do not tell me the sign of a 13-point move.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue about $75M, but the sources disagree: $75.9M with EPS -$1.06 (24/7 Wall St, 2026-11-03, https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/03/hut-8-surges-16-ahead-of-earnings-as-bitcoin-miners-rebound-riot-platforms-surges-14-mara-holdings-jumps-9/); $74.6M with EPS -$0.89 (Benzinga, per search snippet); $72.48M with EPS -$1.25 (Earnings Whispers, per search snippet); EPS about -$0.81 on about $75M (IBTimes AU, 2026-10-15). The company gives no numerical guidance (Q2 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1964789/000110465926090041/tm2621890d1_ex99-1.htm). The bar is disputed, so every finding is capped small. The consensus EPS loss plainly does not model bitcoin fair-value marks.
positioning_check: Short interest 18.15M shares as of 2026-10-15, 2.5 days to cover, on 123.26M shares outstanding, which is about 14.7% of shares out (https://massive.com/quote/hut, read 2026-11-03). The same page gave 19.02M shares and 4.5 days to cover at 2026-09-30 in a search snippet; Equibles had 10.06% of float in August. Insiders own about 10.4% (MarketBeat 2026-11-03), so short interest is roughly 16% of float: crowded-ish. Skew +30.69 vol points (25d put IV over call IV), downside heavily paid; put/call OI 0.56; ATM IV 185%. Tape: -30.3% over 20 days and -51.7% from the 52-week high. The stock fell from about $100 in late September to $55.01 on the 2026-11-02 close, then rebounded about 15-16% intraday on 2026-11-03 with miners (RIOT +14%, MARA +9%). On 2026-11-02 KBW cut its target to $92 from $154 (Outperform), warning of a 'lease catalyst drought' through early 2027.

findings.finding: Bitcoin rose 42.71% in Q3 2026 (about $58.5k at the June 30 settle to $83,556 on the Sept 30 Coinbase close). Hut 8 carried about $1.04B of consolidated digital assets at June 30, 2026 ($567.3M in custody, $184.9M pledged for miner purchases, $290.3M pledged as collateral, per the 10-Q). That implies an unrealized digital-asset gain on the order of $350-450M in Q3, against a $138.6M loss in Q2. GAAP net income and EPS should come out strongly positive against a consensus loss of -$0.81 to -$1.25.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (2025-11-04): a $76.6M gain on digital assets produced $50.6M net income, and the stock fell about 9.65-12.5% that day as BTC fell about 6% (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/35884307/hut-8-reports-third-quarter-2025-results). Q2 2026 (2026-08-04): a $138.6M digital-asset loss, EPS -1.27 against -0.55, and the stock fell 9.74% (https://beincrypto.com/hut-8-stock-q2-2026-earnings/). The marks have not been bought.
findings.why_not_priced: Every published consensus is a loss of $0.81-1.25 a share, so headline EPS will print as a very large 'beat' that screens and algos have not been set up for. The bitcoin price itself is public, and holders who model the mark already know it. If the market had treated the mark as value, the stock would not be down 30% over 20 days while BTC held about $80k+ into mid-October.
findings.independence: BTC quarter return from a second source: Simple Mining's September 2026 report, Sept close $83,556.14 (https://www.simplemining.io/insights/post/bitcoin-market-report-september-2026). The quarter return is from EdgeX/COINOTAG, 42.71% (https://pro.edgex.exchange/en-US/news/article/bitcoin-q3-2026-best-quarter-since-2017). American Bitcoin held about 8,002 BTC at June 30 (https://www.abtc.com/news-and-insights/american-bitcoin-reports-second-quarter-2026-results). The holdings and the price come from different documents.

findings.finding: The street's bar for new AI/HPC leasing at this print is low: KBW cut its target to $92 from $154 on 2026-11-02 and warned of a 'lease catalyst drought' through early 2027. Yet Hut 8 has announced its largest lease alongside a print before (Q1 2026 on 2026-05-06, a $9.8B Beacon Point lease, stock about +35%). It discloses an approximately 8,660 MW development pipeline beyond 949 MW contracted. Any new lease, or River Bend expansion, announced with the release would hit a market positioned for none.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-05-06: Q1 release paired with a $9.8B, 352 MW Beacon Point lease, stock +33-37% (https://parameter.io/hut-8-hut-stock-soars-37-on-massive-9-8b-texas-ai-data-center-agreement/). The prints with no lease news (2026-08-04 -9.7%, 2026-02-25 -6.6%, 2025-11-04 about -10%) all fell.
findings.why_not_priced: A covering analyst has just told clients to expect no lease news, and the stock has halved from its high with puts bid. If a lease were priced, the skew would not be +30 vol points and targets would not be getting cut 40%. This is optionality and not a sourced pending deal: I found no document saying a lease is imminent, so it is sized small despite the large upside tail.
findings.independence: The pipeline and contracted MW are from the Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1964789/000110465926090041/tm2621890d1_ex99-1.htm). The May reaction is from a separate outlet. No document points to a lease at this print.

findings.finding: Beacon Point Phase 2 (the 352 MW, $9.8B lease signed in July 2026) had no financing at the Q2 release ('evaluating a range of structures'). Phase 1 was funded by $4.25B of IG non-recourse notes, and on 2026-09-24 Hut 8 closed a $1.07B four-year parent revolver with JPMorgan, Citi, Goldman and Morgan Stanley, undrawn at close. An update or closing on Phase 2 financing at the print would de-risk the build. The money funds contracted, investment-grade-tenant capacity, not distress.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean print-day precedent. The Phase 1 financing ($4.25B, June 2026) and the River Bend notes ($3.25B, April 2026) were standalone 8-Ks, not print-day items.
findings.why_not_priced: The revolver is public and partly priced. Whether Phase 2 project debt is done is not public. If funding risk on the second $9.8B lease had been taken off the table, it would show up as less put skew and fewer target cuts from 'execution/funding' bears like Cipher's convert-driven selloff.
findings.independence: The Q2 release says Phase 2 financing structures were being evaluated (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1964789/000110465926090041/tm2621890d1_ex99-1.htm). That is a different document from the revolver release.

findings.finding: In the Poolin bankruptcy, Hut 8 was named winning bidder at $140M for the Pyote and Tarbush West Texas sites on 2026-09-23. The court reopened the auction on 2026-09-30 with Hut 8's affiliate as stalking horse at up to $180M ($100M at close plus $80M in AI/cloud milestones). The outcome and terms may be disclosed with the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No precedent on this line at a print.
findings.why_not_priced: It is small next to a roughly $7-8B market cap, and the final status is not public. A finished deal adds powered sites to a pipeline the market is currently discounting.

findings.finding: On-chain analysts flagged about 1,966 BTC (about $161M) moving from Hut 8-linked wallets to exchanges and OTC desks in the week to 2026-10-16, and the company made no statement. A Q4 bitcoin sale is likely to be disclosed as a subsequent event or on the call. What it buys is unanswered: the amount fits the $100M Poolin closing payment plus capex, and the parent also has an undrawn $1.07B revolver, so it is not a distress sale.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell about 7.6% intraday on 2026-10-16 when the transfers were reported (same source), so the market has already reacted once.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock sold off on the report. What is not priced is the confirmed use of the proceeds, which management will explain.
findings.independence: None from a different source on the transfers themselves.

findings.finding: Revenue looks in line at best against a disputed $72.5-75.9M bar. American Bitcoin's Q2 mining revenue was $67.0M on 932 BTC (about $72k realised). Q3 average BTC was roughly similar (Aug average $69,487, Sept average $80,471, July around $60-63k). Network difficulty rose 5.5% in September, and ABTC's reserve rose only about 300 BTC from June 30 to Sept 3. Hut 8 missed revenue consensus in both Q1 2026 ($71M vs $79.4M) and Q2 2026 ($74.9M vs about $79.4M).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue miss: -9.74% (alongside an EPS miss). Q1 2026 revenue miss: +35%, overridden by the lease. Revenue is not the line this stock trades on when lease news is present.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus revenue has run above the print two quarters in a row. Estimates of $75.9M still sit above Q2's $74.9M while realised BTC prices and production look roughly flat. This is a proxy built from BTC averages, not a company number.
findings.independence: BTC monthly averages and difficulty from Simple Mining (https://www.simplemining.io/insights/post/bitcoin-market-report-september-2026). The 8,300 BTC reserve on 2026-09-03 is from Eric Trump via EdgeX (https://pro.edgex.exchange/en-US/news/article/american-bitcoin-8300-btc-reserve-eric-trump-us-lead).

findings.finding: Q3 is the first full quarter carrying both project note issues: $3.25B of 6.192% River Bend notes closed 2026-04-30, and $4.25B of 6.129% Beacon Point notes priced in June 2026. That is about $115M of coupon a quarter against Q2 interest expense of $51.2M, unless it is capitalised during construction. The size of any interest step-up below the line is unknown.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None isolated. Q2's $51.2M interest was part of a print that fell 9.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: Capitalisation policy is not disclosed in what I read. Consensus EPS of -$1.06 against Q2's -$1.27 may or may not carry it. This is an inference, and it is swamped by the BTC mark at the GAAP line.
findings.independence: Note terms are listed on https://massive.com/quote/hut (8-K summaries). This finding shares the Q2 release with findings 2 and 3, but rests on a different number.

findings.finding: Positioning is washed out and short-crowded into the print. The stock fell from about $100 (a director sold at $100.00 on 2026-09-24) to $55.01 on the 2026-11-02 close. Short interest was about 18.15M shares (about 15% of shares out, about 16% of float) at 2026-10-15. The 50-day moving average is $83.46. A quarter with no new negative leaves room for a squeeze, though a +15-16% pre-print rebound on 2026-11-03 used part of it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean precedent. The stock has fallen on 5 of the last 7 prints despite a rising tape for most of 2025-26.
findings.why_not_priced: The +30.7 put skew says the option market is positioned for downside. If the washout were fully priced, implied downside would not be bid this hard after a 45% drawdown. The intraday rebound of 2026-11-03 shows part of it is being unwound now, before the window opens at today's close.
findings.independence: MarketBeat 2026-11-03: 50-day MA $83.46 and insider sale at $100 (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-hut-8-nasdaq-hut-stock-jumps-125-time-to-buy-2026-11-03/).

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive (a mechanical EPS flip, a low lease bar, crowded shorts). That cuts against the +30.7 put skew and a reaction history of 2 up in 7, where the closest analog (a BTC-mark profit in Q3 2025) was sold. It agrees with nothing in the 20-day run-up except that the downside has already been taken, so p_up sits at 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 2 (one-offs) and lesson 1 (reaction history): the BTC fair-value gain is below operating income and was sold in Q3 2025, so it went from +1.0 to +0.5
Lesson 6 (disputed bar, four EPS and three revenue consensus figures): every finding capped small; revenue finding cut from -0.5 to -0.3 and print_vs_bar set to -1.0 from the proxy
Lesson 5 (inference with no document): lease optionality cut from +0.8 to +0.5 and Beacon Point Phase 2 financing from +0.5 to +0.3
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the 1,966 BTC transfer was re-signed after asking what it buys (Poolin closing and capex, revolver undrawn), from -0.2 to -0.1
Lesson 7 (positioning against the skew): positioning finding cut from +0.5 to +0.4 and p_up moved from 53 to 50, so expected_move went from +0.78 to 0
